verdict.rationale: The GST portal homepage publishes an 'Upcoming Due Dates' list with a downloadable PDF, so official filing deadlines are published. Nothing in the pack shows a published late-fee, penalty or interest schedule with exact figures, so only half the story is evidenced, and thinly. Missing for 10: a published late-fee/penalty schedule with exact amounts, interest rates for late payment, confirmation that the due-dates PDF gives exact dates per return type, and independent corroboration.
